src.label: Malta government (servizz.gov.mt) — Pets Arrival Notification, Veterinary Regulation Directorate

head: Every pet must be notified online before arrival, or entry can be denied.
lines: Malta's Veterinary Regulation Directorate runs an online pre-notification of arrival for every pet entering Malta, commercial or not. The owner fills in the arrival details and keeps a printed copy of the form during transport for checks.
The page says that if the entry requirements are not met, the pet's entry is denied: it either goes back to the country of departure or is detained in quarantine.
The service is handled by Animal Welfare - VRD in Marsa and each step is quoted at one working day. The page does not list vaccination, microchip or certificate rules.
